name: ThermaSol Nordic Misty 2-5 Person Outdoor Sauna Cabin
description: Description Transform your backyard into the ultimate private wellness retreat with the superbly crafted Nordic Misty Sauna Cabin. The sauna brings Scandinavian craftsmanship outdoors with a sleek weather resistant design highlighted by the Nordic dark thermo-spruce exterior. Built to withstand harsh outdoor elements, an industrial water-based oil is applied from the factory to darken the wood surface and maintain its UV resistance. Enter through the lockable full-length tinted glass door and you are greeted with an inviting interior ambiance constructed from premium thermo-aspen. Inside the sauna users can unwind upon the smooth thermo-aspen benches while admiring the outdoors from the full length tempered and tinted glass wall, which welcomes significant natural light while maintaining privacy during daytime sauna sessions. Recessed LED mood lighting softly illuminates the cabin from below the bench and above the backrest for an elegant touch. Choose from multiple configurations and pair the sauna with additional Nordic Misty modules to piece together a striking outdoor wellness space Supported by ThermaSol's 2-year warranty, the Nordic Misty outdoor sauna is delivered as a fully assembled plug-and-play unit ready to bring spa-quality therapy steps from your home. Features Nordic dark thermo-spruce exterior for a rich, refined texture and durable weather resistance. Thermo-aspen interior providing enhanced stability and moisture resistance. Full length tempered and tinted glass wall to enhance natural light while maintaining privacy. Full length tempered and tinted glass door comes equipped with a roller latch, wooden handle and external padlock + 2 keys. Soft LED lighting illuminates the cabin from recessed areas to increase ambiance. Lightweight, removable thermo-aspen benches or easy cleaning. Screw connections allow attachment to other Nordic Misty modules. Arrives fully assembled with pre-wired electrical for turnkey use. Small dimensions: 60"W (152.4 cm) x 91"D (231.1 cm) x 100"H (254 cm) Medium dimensions: 87"W (221 cm) x 91"D (231.1 cm) x 100"H (254 cm) Designed and crafted in the U.S.A. What's Included Every configuration includes: Pre-Assembled Sauna Cabin Safety Rails Door Handle Door Lock Stool Accessory Box Hardware Installation Instructions Harvia Stainless Steel Bucket with Handle Harvia Stainless Steel Ladle with Handle Harvia Thermometer & Hygrometer Combo Your selected configuration also includes: Small · Electric: Harvia 6kW SPIRIT Heater with Wi-Fi Harvia Xenio CX45 Wi-Fi digital control 4 boxes of R-991 sauna stones Small · Wood-Burning: Harvia Legend 150 Wood-Burning Heater Kit 8 boxes of AC3020 sauna stones Steel chimney Hearth plate Harvia smoke pipe guard Medium · Electric: Harvia 9kW VIRTA Heater with Wi-Fi Harvia Xenio CX45 Wi-Fi digital control 3 boxes of AC3020 sauna stones Medium · Wood-Burning: Harvia Legend 240 Wood-Burning Heater Kit 12 boxes of AC3020 sauna stones Steel chimney Hearth plate Harvia smoke pipe guard Specifications Specification Small Medium Recommended capacity 2-3 people 4-5 people Exterior (W × D × H) 60″ × 91″ × 100″ 87″ × 91″ × 100″ Sauna type: Traditional (Finnish) Installation: Outdoor, freestanding Lead time: Made to order, 12 weeks (plus 5–10 business days delivery) Shipping & Lead Time Freight is quoted separately for every order based on your delivery location and configuration. After you place your order, our team will contact you with your shipping quote before your build begins. Saunas are delivered fully assembled via flatbed trailer, and you'll be notified roughly two weeks before the scheduled delivery. A forklift or crane is required for placement, and a licensed electrician must connect the heater — manual offloading is not recommended.
